exchanges: ugh midterm season is eating me alive
Hang in there, it's always the worst stretch.
linguistics sounded fun when i picked it, now its all phonetics charts
The charts get easier once the sounds click.
i keep mixing up the symbols for two of the vowels
Flashcards with audio might help those stick.
the library at corriveau is open til midnight at least
Late library hours are a lifesaver this time of year.
my brother bought a miata, midlife crisis came early
A little convertible is a classic choice for that.
he sent me a million pics of it
Sounds like he's very proud of it.
ines is practicing bassoon in the next room and its so loud
That's a big sound to study through.
headphones are on max lol
Noise cancelling would earn its keep today.
my uncle tobias got shingles, poor guy is miserable
That sounds really painful, I hope he feels better soon.
putting on alvvays to drown out the practicing, they never miss
Good music for a focus session.
is coffe this late a bad idea
Probably, if you want any sleep tonight.
cracked my fairphone screen on the bus stop bench
Oh no, at least those are easy to repair yourself.
ordered the replacement part already
Nice, quick fix then.
my brother in law just picked up a sienna so the family van era begins
Welcome to the minivan life for him.
family dinner sunday is going to be all car talk
Maybe bring a topic of your own just in case.
ines grew up in vellacourt so she thinks this city is tiny
Funny how hometown size shapes that.
my grandma got hooked on taskmaster, she calls me after every episode
Love that, it's a great one to share.
she does the impressions too its hilarious
That sounds like the best phone call.
finally caved and bought a dehumidifier, the basement apartment is so damp
That should make a big difference with the damp.
it already filled up once
Wow, it was clearly needed.
ok back to the phonetics
You've got this, one chart at a time.
my sister odalys just sent me a cat video to help me study lol
Very supportive procrastination aid.
gonna go bouldering after to clear my head
Climbing is a great way to reset.
or maybe just sleep, we'll see
Either one sounds like a good call.
